summary.text: Abigail Salisbury is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 34 who has served since February 21, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Abigail Salisbury was born in Conneaut, Ohio, and graduated from Fairview High School in 2000.

She earned a bachelor's degree from Case Western Reserve University in 2004, a master's degree in public policy and management from the University of Pittsburgh in 2007, and a juris doctor from the University of Pittsburgh in 2013.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney with Salisbury Legal, LLC, and as program director of the Pittsburgh Haiti Symposium.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Salisbury said she is a solo attorney in Swissvale Borough and had served as Swissvale Council president.
She described her campaign principles as "Service, Safety, Success."
Salisbury assumed office on February 21, 2023, succeeding Summer Lee.
